note: CD4 memory layout on CCR7 × CD45RA. Strategy: (1) CD4_Naive anchors on the dense blob at the upper-right corner (CCR7 very high, CD45RA high). (2) CD4_Effector (EMRA) sits to the left of CD4_Naive in the upper CD45RA band (rare in CD4). (3) In the lower CD45RA band, CCR7 is bimodal — locate the left edge / shoulder of the CCR7+ peak; CD4_Central_Memory (lymph-node homing) sits at/right of this edge (includes the dense CCR7+ peak), CD4_Effector_Memory sits to its left.
tips: CD4 differentiation subsets (canonical Sallusto/Lanzavecchia scheme on CCR7 × CD45RA). CD4_Naive: CCR7+ CD45RA+. CD4_Central_Memory: CCR7+ CD45RA-. CD4_Effector_Memory: CCR7- CD45RA-. CD4_Effector: CCR7- CD45RA+ (the file label `CD4_Effector` is a shorthand for TEMRA). Useful co-markers: CD27 / CD28 would refine the EM differentiation axis but are not in this panel.
